question: Where can I get electricity consumption by municipality or postal code in Spain, by sector and year?

answer.summary: Spain publishes no national file of electricity use by municipality or postal code. Best: Catalonia (ICAEN, 947 municipalities, 6 sectors, kWh, 2013-2024, API) and Canarias (ISTAC, monthly, 3 sectors, MWh). Postal codes: Barcelona city by sector, and E-REDES/Viesgo/Begasa areas as totals. Other regions give totals, residential only, or per-capita figures. National bodies (CNMC, REE, MITECO) stop at region or province.
main_caveats: Units differ: Catalonia kWh, Canarias and Andalusia MWh, Basque kWh per inhabitant; Barcelona is labelled MWh but behaves as kWh.
Sector categories are not comparable across sources (6 in Catalonia, 3 in Canarias and Barcelona, industrial vs non-industrial in the Basque Country).
Andalusian figures cover only the Endesa network; municipalities served by others show 0 MWh.
Catalonia leaves cells empty under statistical secrecy (10,099 of 54,611 rows); sums by municipality can be incomplete.
No municipal data found for Galicia, Aragon, Valencia, Asturias, Cantabria, Castilla-La Mancha, Extremadura, Baleares; Murcia only a 2014 PDF.
answer.confidence_reason: National negatives opened at CNMC, MITECO, REE and INE; sources tested by download or API. Several regions only checked through searches plus partial pages; i-DE site returned 503.
